paragraphs: As of Tuesday, October 6, before the U.S. open, the Nasdaq setup remains modestly constructive after Monday’s technology-led rally carried the Composite to a record close. AI and mega-cap leadership remained supportive into the overnight session, while reduced expectations for another immediate Fed hike continued to help risk appetite.

The counterweight remains the long end of the Treasury market and the oil-inflation channel. Long yields are still unusually restrictive for technology valuations, while Middle East supply risk means crude can quickly reintroduce inflation pressure. The quality of semiconductor breadth therefore matters more than a small positive index-futures indication by itself.

catalysts.title: U.S. trade balance — 8:30 ET / 15:30 Istanbul
catalysts.detail: The Treasury-market reaction matters more than the headline deficit; a large growth or dollar surprise could move long yields and therefore Nasdaq duration sensitivity.

catalysts.title: Treasury yields versus record-high technology — throughout the session
catalysts.detail: Stable long yields with firm semiconductor participation would confirm that AI earnings momentum is overpowering the discount-rate headwind; another material long-end surge would raise consolidation risk.

catalysts.title: Middle East oil flows and geopolitical risk — ongoing
catalysts.detail: Renewed shipping or infrastructure disruption could reverse recent oil relief and feed directly into inflation expectations and Treasury yields.

catalysts.title: AI infrastructure and semiconductor breadth
catalysts.detail: Strong AI demand remains supportive, but power and deployment constraints can narrow leadership toward the best-insulated semiconductor and mega-cap names.

watchIntoOpen: What I’d watch into the open: the upside case is Nasdaq futures holding firm, oil remaining contained, the 10-year stopping its advance, and semiconductor participation broadening alongside the mega-caps. The downside case is another simultaneous rise in crude and long yields, especially if secondary semiconductor names begin lagging while only a handful of mega-caps keep the index elevated.
keyTimes: The U.S. cash market opens at 9:30 ET / 16:30 Istanbul. The main scheduled pre-open data point is the 8:30 ET / 15:30 Istanbul trade balance; thereafter Treasury yields, oil and semiconductor breadth are the important live catalysts.
sources: Reuters — U.S. markets, global markets, Middle East oil and AI infrastructure
